Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves; fruit develops brown corky scabs.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5 mL/L.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Prune infected canopy twigs and clear fallen leaf litter beneath trees.

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Frog-eye leaf spots with purple margins; firm rot on fruit expanding in concentric rings.
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Apply Captan 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP @ 1 g/L.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Remove dead wood, mummified fruits, and fire blight cankers during dormant pruning.

Apple___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous green leaves without chlorotic lesions or necrosis.
Apple___healthy.treatment: No fungicide required. Maintain standard micronutrient foliar spray (Zinc, Boron).
Apple___healthy.prevention: Follow standard balanced N-P-K orchard nutrition.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Golden-brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant certified rust-resistant maize hybrids; avoid excessive high-density planting.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long elliptical, cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions parallel to leaf veins.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 mL/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Deep summer ploughing to bury crop residue; 2-year crop rotation with non-host crops.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.symptoms: Dark green, robust leaves with intact parallel venation.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: No chemical intervention needed. Ensure split Nitrogen application at knee-high stage.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Maintain timely weed control and optimum field drainage.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown circular leaf spots with tiny black pycnidia; shriveled black mummified berries.
Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Spray Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2 g/L before bloom and fruit set.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Maintain vine canopy training (Bower/Y-trellis) for maximum sunlight and aeration.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Tiger-stripe interveinal chlorosis and necrosis on leaves; dark spotting on berry skin.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Protect pruning wounds with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP paste; no single systemic cure.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Disinfect pruning shears between vines; remove and burn severely declining vines.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant lobed leaves without spotting or margin burn.
Grape___healthy.treatment: No fungicide needed. Apply prophylactic organic Trichoderma viride drench.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Standard shoot thinning and balanced potassium fertigation.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric target-board ring lesions on older leaves, surrounded by yellow chlorotic halo.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 mL/L.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; practice 3-year solanaceous crop rotation.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions rapidly expanding in cool humid weather with white mildew under leaf.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Immediately spray Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L or Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified disease-free seed tubers; ensure proper earthing-up to shield tubers.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Full green compound leaves with upright stem vigor.
Potato___healthy.treatment: No fungicide application needed. Maintain earthing up and soil moisture.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Scout field weekly during high humidity weather.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small angular dark water-soaked leaf spots; margins turn yellow with necrotic tears.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide 53.8% DF @ 2 g/L mixed with Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use hot-water treated certified seeds; avoid handling plants while foliage is wet.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Target-board concentric ring spots on lower foliage; premature defoliation.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 mL/L.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Mulch around base to prevent soil splash; stake tomato vines off the ground.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large irregular dark greasy water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems with white fungal mold.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Spray Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2 g/L or Fosetyl-Al 80% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Ensure wide spacing (60x45 cm) for canopy aeration; destroy infected plants immediately.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green or yellowish spots on upper leaf surface with olive-green velvety mold underneath.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Difenoconazole @ 0.5 mL/L.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Reduce humidity below 85% in polyhouses/fields; prune lower suckers for ventilation.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous circular small spots (1-3mm) with gray centers and dark brown margins.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L at first symptom appearance.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotate crops; remove volunteer nightshade family weeds around field borders.

Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Brown lesions with pinpoint centers and concentric zones on leaves and stems.
Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 mL/L or Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1 g/L.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Ensure balanced nitrogen fertilization; avoid water stress during fruiting.

Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe upward curling and cupping of leaflets, marginal chlorosis, stunted bushy plant growth.
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: Virus cannot be cured; control whitefly vector: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L or Neem Oil @ 3 mL/L.
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Install Yellow Sticky Traps @ 15 traps/acre; rogue out early infected symptomatic plants.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green serrated foliage without spotting, curling, or mildew.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: No pesticide required. Apply bio-fertilizer (Pseudomonas fluorescens) as soil drench.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Maintain consistent drip irrigation and calcium feeding to prevent blossom end rot.
